get.description: Retrieve a page of marketing campaigns from your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to sort, filter, and paginate through campaigns, making it useful for managing and analyzing your marketing efforts.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A string to filter campaigns by name.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: An array of property names to include in the response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A string to specify the sorting order of the results.

post.description: Create a campaign with the specified properties and receive a copy of the object, including its ID. Note that the 'hs_goal' property is deprecated and will be ignored if provided.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: List all supported campaign asset types. This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of asset types that can be used in campaigns, which is useful for understanding the available options when creating or managing campaign assets.

post.description: Delete a batch of campaigns using their identifiers. This endpoint allows you to efficiently remove multiple campaigns at once, streamlining the process of managing campaign data. It is particularly useful for cleaning up outdated or unnecessary campaigns in bulk.

Create a batch of marketing campaigns with specified properties. This endpoint allows for the creation of multiple campaigns in a single request. Note that the 'hs_goal' property is deprecated and will be ignored if included in the request.

Retrieve a batch of campaigns using specified parameters. This endpoint allows you to filter campaigns by date range and select specific properties to include in the response. It is useful for obtaining detailed information about multiple campaigns at once.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for filtering campaigns, formatted as a string.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of property names to include in the response.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for filtering campaigns, formatted as a string.

post.description: Update a batch of campaigns with the specified properties. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple campaigns in a single request. Note: The 'hs_goal' property is deprecated and will be ignored if provided.

Clone a campaign identified by sourceCampaignGuid in the request body. The cloned campaign will have its own GUID and the provided properties. Asset cloning is performed asynchronously. Use the clone-status endpoint to check progress.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: List the portal-wide asset types that can be cloned in a campaign clone operation.
Check the status of an asynchronous campaign clone operation. The campaignGuid path parameter should be the GUID of the new campaign returned by the clone endpoint.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the new campaign returned by the clone endpoint.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific marketing campaign identified by its internal ID. This endpoint allows you to access campaign information and associated assets. It is useful for obtaining campaign data for analysis or reporting purposes.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign to retrieve.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for filtering campaign data, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of property names to include in the response.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for filtering campaign data, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

delete.description: Delete a specified campaign from the system. This operation will remove the campaign identified by the given campaignGuid from your HubSpot account.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign to delete.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of a campaign identified by the specified ID. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string. Note: The 'hs_goal' property is deprecated and will be ignored if provided.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign to update.

get.description: List all assets of a specific campaign by asset type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve various assets associated with a campaign, filtered by the type of asset. It supports pagination to handle large sets of results.

parameters.name: assetType
parameters.description: The type of asset to filter the list.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for filtering assets, formatted as a string.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for filtering assets, formatted as a string.

put.description: Associate an asset with a specific campaign. This operation links an asset of a specified type and ID to a campaign identified by its unique campaignGuid. It is useful for organizing and managing campaign assets within HubSpot.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the asset to be associated with the campaign.

parameters.name: assetType
parameters.description: The type of asset being associated with the campaign.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign to which the asset will be associated.

delete.description: Disassociate an asset from a specified campaign. This operation removes the link between the asset and the campaign, effectively detaching the asset from the campaign's context.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the asset to be disassociated from the campaign.

parameters.name: assetType
parameters.description: The type of asset to be disassociated from the campaign.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign from which the asset will be disassociated.

post.description: Add a new budget item to the specified campaign. This endpoint allows you to associate financial allocations with a campaign, enabling better tracking and management of campaign budgets.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign to which the budget item will be added.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve detailed budget and spending information, including totals, for a specific marketing campaign. This endpoint provides insights into the financial aspects of a campaign, helping users to manage and analyze budget allocations and spending patterns effectively.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign for which budget totals are being retrieved.

get.description: Retrieve a specific budget item associated with a campaign using its unique budget ID. This endpoint is useful for accessing detailed information about a particular budget item within a campaign, allowing for review and analysis of budget allocations.

parameters.name: budgetId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the budget item, represented as an integer.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

put.description: Update a specific budget item by ID within a marketing campaign. This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a budget item associated with a campaign, identified by its unique campaignGuid and budgetId. Use this to adjust budget allocations or update budget-related information for a campaign.

parameters.name: budgetId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the budget item to update.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

delete.description: Delete a specific budget item by its ID from a campaign. This operation is useful for removing budget allocations that are no longer needed or were added in error.

parameters.name: budgetId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the budget item to be deleted.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign from which the budget item will be deleted.

get.description: Fetch the list of contact IDs for the specified campaign and contact type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve contact information associated with a particular campaign, filtered by the type of contact. It supports pagination and date filtering to manage large sets of data effectively.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

parameters.name: contactType
parameters.description: The type of contact to filter the list.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for filtering contact data, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for filtering contact data, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

get.description: Fetch the metrics of a specific marketing campaign using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to gather insights into campaign performance over a specified date range.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for fetching campaign metrics, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for fetching campaign metrics, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

get.description: Fetch revenue attribution report data for a specific campaign. This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed revenue attribution metrics, which can be filtered by attribution model and date range. This data is useful for analyzing the financial impact of marketing campaigns.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

parameters.name: attributionModel
parameters.description: The attribution model to use for the revenue report. Specify the model to filter the data accordingly.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date to fetch attribution data, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date to fetch attribution data, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

post.description: Create a new campaign spend item for a specified campaign. This endpoint allows you to add financial details related to campaign expenditures, which can help in tracking and managing marketing budgets effectively.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign for which the spend item is being created.

get.description: Retrieve a specific campaign spend item using its unique spendId. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a particular spend item associated with a campaign, which can be useful for tracking and managing campaign expenses.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

parameters.name: spendId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the spend item to retrieve.

put.description: Update a specific campaign spend item by its unique spendId. This operation allows you to modify the details of an existing spend item associated with a campaign, such as its amount or description.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

parameters.name: spendId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the spend item to update.

delete.description: Delete a specific campaign spend item by its ID. This operation is useful for managing and cleaning up spend records associated with a particular marketing campaign.

parameters.name: campaignGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

parameters.name: spendId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the spend item to delete.
